values.content:
=You are a Google Shopping and product SEO expert.

Business: {{ $('load-config').item.json.business_name }}
Website: {{ $('load-config').item.json.website_url }}

Product pages found:
{{ $json.product_urls }}

For each product, generate a complete Google Merchant Centre feed entry:
- id: unique product SKU or URL slug
- title: SEO-optimised product title (max 150 chars, include brand + key descriptor + material/size if relevant)
- description: 500-word product description optimised for Google Shopping (includes: primary keyword, secondary keywords, features, benefits, specifications, use cases)
- google_product_category: Most specific Google product taxonomy category
- product_type: Internal product type
- link: Product URL
- image_link: Main product image URL
- availability: in stock / out of stock / preorder
- price: (pull from page or mark as NEEDS_UPDATE if not found)
- brand: {{ $('load-config').item.json.business_name }}
- condition: new
- shipping: AU standard shipping
- custom_labels: Array of 5 custom labels for campaign segmentation (e.g. bestseller, high_margin, seasonal, new_arrival)

Also generate:
- shopping_campaign_structure: How to organise these products into Shopping ad campaigns (by category, margin, seasonality)
- performance_max_asset_groups: 3 Performance Max asset group names with headlines and descriptions

Return as JSON with field 'feed_items' containing array of product objects.

nodes.name: Claude — Generate Optimised Product Feed
nodes.notes: Claude reads product pages and generates fully optimised Google Merchant Centre feed entries with Shopping-specific titles and descriptions

nodes.name: Upload Feed to Google Merchant Centre
nodes.notes: Uploads the optimised product feed to Google Merchant Centre via Content API v2.1

values.content:
=You are a Google Local Service Ads expert for Australian trades and service businesses.

Business: {{ $('load-config').item.json.business_name }}
Industry: {{ $('load-config').item.json.industry }}
City: {{ $('load-config').item.json.city }}
Services offered: {{ $('load-config').item.json.services }}

Generate a complete Google Local Service Ads setup package:

1. lsa_business_description: 300-char LSA business description (emphasise response time, licensing, guarantee)

2. service_list: All eligible LSA services for this industry category (formatted exactly as Google LSA service names)

3. service_areas: All suburbs to enable as service areas (pull from business config suburbs list)

4. business_hours: Recommended operating hours for maximum LSA visibility

5. budget_recommendation: Weekly LSA budget recommendation based on industry and city size

6. google_guarantee_checklist: Step-by-step list of documents needed to get Google Guaranteed badge (licence numbers, insurance, background check process for AU)

7. ad_headline_variants: 5 headline variants to A/B test (focus on response time, guarantee, pricing transparency)

8. negative_keywords: 20 negative keywords to exclude irrelevant clicks

Return as JSON.
